scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:preview" --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev:preview
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
